title: tshark: allow --capture-comment when reading a file
description:
Allows adding one or more capture comments to a new pcapng file when
tshark is reading from a file. Currently, tshark only allows setting one
capture comment, and that only when doing a live capture.

The use case for this feature is given in bug #15005.
I decided to allow multiple capture comments to match the same ability
in `editcap`.

To allow this change, I changed the function signature of
`process_cap_file()` so it takes a `capture_options` struct instead of
individual parameters that affect the capture.

Closes #15005

As noted in [this comment for another merge request](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/3640#note_625966251), this breaks build without pcap (`-DENABLE_PCAP=NO` passed to CMake).

And the problem is that, without pcap, there's no packet capture, and thus no `global_capture_opts`.

The word "capture" in `--capture-comment` doesn't mean "comment applied as part of the capture process", it means "comment for (the first SHB of) the capture file", and thus it doesn't belong in `global_capture_opts`; it should be moved elsewhere.

This option applies to editcap, dumpcap and tshark:

- editcap does no capturing, just capture-file reading;
- dumpcap does *only* capturing;
- tshark does both capturing and capture-file reading.

(There's also Wireshark, which, like tshark, does both, but, although its usage message claims it supports it, it doesn't.  That's a bug and should be fixed.)
Noted! It may take me a few days but I'll see what I can do.
To resolve this thread, Guy fixed this in 0822e8b3e52013aebceb1fe59fdb11ad69dea40f.
